name: jev
description: Calibrated yes/no, pick-one and rubric decisions for coding agents: rank and triage hundreds of items without reading them, pick the tests a change can break, review hunks by risk, cluster a red suite by cause; a guard on Bash that asks and never allows, an injection screen on WebFetch, and a per-session view of what it kept out of the context.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: A TypeSafe key (console.typesafe.ai) or an OpenRouter key (sk-or-…). Stored with mode 0600 on the next session start; leave empty if you use `jev auth set` or TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: typesafe or openrouter. Empty: detected from the key (sk-or- means OpenRouter), else TypeSafe.

guard_mode.title: Bash guard
guard_mode.description: ask: prompt before a command that looks destructive (p >= 0.60). deny: also deny at p >= 0.90 where no prompt can appear. off: no guard.

screen_mode.title: WebFetch screen
screen_mode.description: on: add a line of context when fetched text reads like instructions aimed at an agent (p >= 0.55). off: no screen.
